name: Vanessa Blazey
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Vanessa has lived experience of mental health challenges and as a client herself, she understands the profound value in having “the right fit” in a successful, professional client-counsellor relationship. When working with children, young people and adults who have experienced trauma this looks like working alongside the client’s health care professionals towards the same goal to avoid retraumatisation and ensure continuity and positive outcomes. Vanessa has worked as a counsellor in various services, including school settings, crisis support, drug and alcohol rehabilitation and across a broad range of issues including Anxiety, Depression, Trauma. Vanessa has a keen personal interest in maternal mental health, the mother-infant relationship, birth trauma and human rights.

name: Sharon Rowland
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Passionate about working alongside couples and individuals to realise their potential. I bring years of experience and training into a safe and welcoming space.

name: Marcus Mogford
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Marcus is a registered counsellor and Gestalt psychotherapist who has worked in a variety of mental health settings since 2016. His clinical practice has focused on areas such as anxiety, depression, trauma, self-esteem, grief, suicidal ideation, and challenges in relationships. Marcus primarily uses a Gestalt approach, but also draws on attachment theory, Internal Family Systems, relational neuroscience, trauma-informed treatment modalities, and psychospiritual approaches in accordance with the needs and interests of his clients.

name: Kathy Toomey
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
practice: Kids and Teens Counselling and Psychotherapy
description: I have over 20 years experience working with children and families in the education sector as teacher, leader and school counsellor/psychotherapist. In private practice I specialise in Counselling and Psychotherapy for Kids and Teens. (Ages 4-25).

name: Kara John
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hi, my name is Kara. And as a therapist, I bring my whole self to you in an open, non-judgmental, and compassionate way. I became a counsellor later in life.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Leyna Fennell
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Leyna is a Counsellor, Psychotherapist and Clinical Supervisor; she works with individuals, couples, families and other mental health professionals. She welcomes people from all backgrounds, culture, gender, sexuality, age and ability. Leyna has extensive experience in working with those impacted by trauma, grief and loss and significant life changes, having worked in the field of Mental Health, Addiction, Family Violence, Sexual Violence and Grief and Bereavement over the past 11 years.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Desanka Desa Ogrizovic
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Clinical Counsellor working within a multidisciplinary healthcare setting, providing psychological and emotional support to individuals undergoing bariatric and metabolic surgery. I support clients through evidence-informed counselling interventions that enhance insight, emotional regulation, coping skills, and sustainable habit change, recognising the complex interaction between mental health, stress, trauma, and physical wellbeing. I also practice through Desa Holistic Wellbeing ( www.desaholisticwellbeing.com.au ), where I provide counselling grounded in a holistic, client-centred, and trauma-informed framework.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy
